## 0. Operator Quick Start — AI / HGK / Human

### 0.1 Web GPT 指揮官：收到 SWOF「開始 / 繼續 / 修補 / 驗收」任務時

1. 載入既有 `construction-acceptance-prompt-compiler` root + canonical support bundle；本 Runbook 只作 project-specific `DERIVED_OPERATIONAL_PROJECTION`。
2. 驗證本 Runbook version/source lineage；若 current source corpus、PI/PD decision corpus或 carry-forward digest 任一 stale，先重新 freeze，不得沿用舊 conversation memory。
3. **G-KNOW 是 repo mutation 前 hard gate**：對 exact `source_corpus_root` 完成 full-corpus Source Freeze，再以 HGK 現行受治理 Knowledge Workbench 物化 `Source Ledger → normalized locator → chunk/anchor registry → SQLite/FTS5 local-first retrieval（或 fresh-qualified native substitute）→ optional KG candidate → positive/negative retrieval probes`；只有 `SWOF-AI-KNOWLEDGE-ADMISSION/1 = PASS` 才能進 RepoContext/PD04 mutation。
4. fresh-read `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\HG-KSEOS` 與 `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\Fabric`，建立 `SWOF-ENGINEERING-BASE-REUSE/1`：列出可重用模組、實際被消費契約、do-not-redo、gap與不相容項；projection/manual不得冒充 current machine truth。
5. repo mutation 必須先走 `PD03 RepoContext → PD04 construction packet → TaskSpecSeed → TaskSpec → WorkOrder → ONE ECP`。
6. 每個 major gate先填 `SWOF-GATE-CALIBRATION/1`：objective、risk tier、strictness、negative/adversarial、regression baseline、anti-overfit、deterministic oracle、LLM-judge counterbalance、HITL、TT/CR、raw evidence、fail-closed。
7. 用既有 Prompt Compiler 編譯 C0–C9；blocked 時輸出 exact blocker/close evidence，不渲染 executable HGK prompt。
8. compile pass 後只輸出既有十段薄 Prompt；不得貼入 34 package bodies、本 Runbook或全量 ledgers。
9. 外部驗收只讀 exact `source_candidate_sha` + exact `evidence_commit_sha`；不得以 branch tip / merge SHA / CI green單獨代替 acceptance subject。
10. Verdict 只能是 `PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL / TEMP_CLOSED`，claim 不得高於證據。

### 0.2 HGK / Hermes / Codex：收到合規薄 Prompt 時

`source admission → source freeze → AI knowledge admission → engineering-base reuse inventory → Requirement freeze → RepoContext → PD04 packet → TaskSpec → WorkOrder → ExecutionBinding → bounded workspace → implement → focused test → smallest-affected repair → regression/security/negative → independent checker → checkpoint → candidate publication → evidence publication`

- `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF` 是 local canonical construction target / accepted integration root；current task授權 ceiling 僅涵蓋此 target root內必要修改，任何 root 外 mutation、credential、external side effect仍需其獨立權限/authority。
- `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\HG-KSEOS` 是 HGK canonical local root；`C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\Fabric` 是 contract surface。
- exact source corpus root見 §7.2；source files readonly，AI knowledge/RAG/KG/Obsidian projection不得取得 canonical authority。
- GitHub `shw097-team/SWOF` 只作 `ACCEPTANCE_MIRROR_ONLY`；不得成為施工 root、HGK normative root、runtime truth或 semantic truth。
- **repo-mutating durable WorkOrder 一律 unique branch**；只有 truly atomic/direct/non-durable bounded mutation可由HGK deterministic route不開 durable branch。worktree只在並行/跨角色/可重啟/高風險/遷移/clean-isolation需要時啟用。
- remote CI只驗 repo-portable deterministic predicates；host-bound/runtime/world-effect必須由 qualified environment evidence 關閉。
- candidate publication 只有在 `LocalClosureReceipt + IndependentReceipt + checkpoint` 對同一 WorkOrder / same HEAD 全 PASS 時才成為 `EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_CANDIDATE`。
- 每次修補產生新的 immutable candidate identity，舊 evidence依 dependency invalidation規則失效。

### 0.3 Human：只處理 authority edge

Human 不負責日常 route、agent選擇、worktree、test、repair、candidate evolution；只依 §18 WI 處理 credentials/org authorization、destructive scope expansion、equal-rank/constitutional conflict、high-impact world effect、break-glass、Release/Production final authority。

### 0.4 Fail-closed shorthand

```text
NO SOURCE / STALE FREEZE       => TEMP_CLOSED_SOURCE / PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED
NO AI KNOWLEDGE ADMISSION      => KNOWLEDGE_GATE_BLOCKED / NO REPO MUTATION
NO CURRENT HGK/FABRIC REUSE MAP=> TEMP_CLOSED_STATE / NO DO-NOT-REDO CLAIM
NO REPOCONTEXT                 => DISCOVERY FIRST / NO MUTATION
NO PD04 PACKET                 => FAIL_PD04_ROUTE / NO MUTATION
NO GATE CALIBRATION ROW        => FAIL_GATE_CALIBRATION / NO PROMOTION
NO LOCAL CLOSURE RECEIPTS      => FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH
AMBIGUOUS SOURCE SHA           => FAIL_SHA_CONFUSION
PRODUCER == CHECKER            => FAIL_SOD
NO REDACTION/SECRET-SCAN PASS  => FAIL_SECURITY
NO EVIDENCE COMMIT             => TEMP_CLOSED_EVIDENCE_ID
CI GREEN ONLY                  => NO RUNTIME/WORLD-EFFECT PASS
GITHUB UNAVAILABLE             => LOCAL TRUTH PRESERVED; EXTERNAL ACCEPTANCE TEMP_CLOSED
COMPILER SUPPORT BUNDLE MISSING=> PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED
INDEPENDENT/HUMAN/RELEASE GAP  => CLAIM REMAINS BELOW THAT GATE
```

## 2. Runbook/WI 目的、範圍、啟動條件與非目標

### 2.1 目的

本文件把 SWOF/HGK 自動化自舉施工與驗收決策 materialize 成可供新對話重用的 project-specific operational projection，使 `GPTs_GENIEMAKER_開發實作+驗收指揮官` 能在不依賴 conversation memory 的情況下：

- 正確掛載既有 Prompt Compiler，編譯 C0–C9，再輸出薄 HGK executor Prompt；
- 對 PI-PKG-00..17、PD-PKG-00..15 執行 source-bound、claim-honest、full-corpus/no-sampling 的初始 freeze 與 task-time progressive retrieval；
- 以現版 HGK/Fabric 作工程基座，在本地 `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF` 完成施工、檢測、最小修補、自迭代與本地獨立驗收；
- 使用 PD03/PD04 把 source contract 轉為 RepoContext、TaskSpec、WorkOrder、ONE ECP 與 evidence edges；
- 只在必要情況使用 branch/worktree isolation，避免 worktree-everywhere；
- 將 GitHub 嚴格限制為 acceptance mirror/transport，並以 exact source SHA + exact evidence SHA 供 Web GPT read-only external acceptance；
- 讓 Human 只處理不能安全自動化的 authority edge；
- 在任何 source/runtime/evidence缺口下 fail closed，而不是用文件存在、工具回應或 CI green 冒充 PASS。

### 2.2 啟動條件

當任務符合任一條件即啟動本 Runbook：

- target/project 明確為 `SWOF`、`SWOF-F`、`SWOF GENIE`；
- governing source 包含 `PI-PKG-00..17` / `PD-PKG-00..15`；
- 要求 HGK 對 `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF` 做 implementation/repair/qualification/acceptance；
- 要求建立/使用 `shw097-team/SWOF` GitHub acceptance bridge；
- 要求 Web GPT 對 SWOF exact candidate 做 external acceptance。

## 4. 權威堆疊、衝突政策與 Source-Quality Gate

### 4.1 裁決順序

1. **System / Developer / current explicit user task controls**。
2. **Current SWOF PI/PD canonical package sources**，只在各自 claim ceiling 內。
3. **Current HG-KSEOS / Fabric machine truth**：真實 Master/Stage contracts、RepoContext、config、seals、receipts、runtime state；operator manuals僅作 projection/locator。
4. **GPT-B canonical Knowledge / rule contracts**，但須先通過 source-quality gate。
5. **Prompt Compiler procedural contract**：定義 C0–C9 / render / evidence / termination；不取得 product authority。
6. **本 SWOF Runbook/WI**：`DERIVED_OPERATIONAL_PROJECTION`。
7. **Discussion/history**：只作 decision lineage，須被較高 rank/current source reconcile。
8. **Web/GitHub/OpenSSF/community/research**：`SUPPORT_ONLY`。

同 rank衝突不得 silent merge；任何 lower-rank source不得透過「較新、較熱門、較方便」升格覆寫 higher authority。來源：`01_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY.md`; PI00 authority freeze；Compiler `L12-L17,L25-L34`；AUDIT `L87-L101`。

### 4.2 Truth partitions

```text
NAMED
!= SELECTED
!= MATERIALIZED
!= INSTALLED
!= BOUND
!= ENABLED
!= RUNTIME_READY
!= QUALIFIED
!= INDEPENDENT_PASS
!= HUMAN_RATIFIED
!= RELEASE_CANDIDATE
!= PRODUCTION_PASS
```

任何工具、技術、provider、workflow、repo、Skill、CI、RAG/KG、external acceptance都必須保留此分層。

### 4.4 Source-quality preflight

在任何新對話生成 SWOF executor prompt 前：

```text
load higher authority
→ identify all rule rows used by planned action
→ if row is in quarantine set: do not consume polarity
→ resolve from higher-authority source / current machine contract if available
→ otherwise mark rule UNVERIFIED and remove it from executable instruction
→ open CR_SOURCE_QUALITY with close locator
```

**Gate:** `20/20 R04 = QUARANTINED_OR_RECONCILED`; zero quarantined row may silently govern execution. AUDIT re-acceptance gate `L609-L620`.

## 5. Operational RCA / 為何必須使用本 Runbook

### 5.1 根因樹

```text
症狀 A：新對話容易重新討論、重新設計、產出不同 Prompt
├─ 根因 A1：關鍵決策只存在長對話，conversation memory不是可靠 state store
│  └─ 證據：15_MEMORY_STATE_TRACE_REPLAY.md:L48-L54；討論 L4178-L4210
├─ 根因 A2：Prompt Compiler只有root SKILL，supporting bundle未掛載
│  └─ 證據：SKILL:L19,L23,L36,L57-L68,L72；本次 filesystem probe = 8 items Missing
└─ 根因 A3：專案特定規則尚未 materialize 成版本化 derived operational projection
   └─ 證據：討論 L4178-L4209

症狀 B：容易把 GitHub/CI 誤解成施工 authority
├─ 根因 B1：協作/驗收 transport 與 local normative runtime 未分層
│  └─ 證據：討論 L1044-L1069；HGK:L23-L30
└─ 根因 B2：remote check 很容易被當成 runtime/world-effect proxy

├─ 根因 C1：把機制誤升格成 architecture invariant
│  └─ 證據：討論 L2894,L4008-L4044,L4050-L4058
└─ 根因 C2：未依 task shape / host-bound applicability route
   └─ 證據：HGK deterministic Direct/Kanban/Swarm router

   └─ 修正：source=commit SHA；package=SHA-256；runtime/effect=subject-bound receipt
```

### 5.2 核心根因結論

真正的缺口不是再造更多 orchestrator，而是缺少一個**可攜、版本化、可按需載入的 SWOF operational projection**，以及完整 Prompt Compiler bundle。故最小修改為：

> **既有 Compiler Skill + 1份 RUNBOOK/WI reference + regression probes；無第二 Skill/Orchestrator/MCP。**

---

### 5.3 AUDIT-driven repair RCA

```text
r1 symptom: domain-level W0-W5 compression looked complete
→ root cause: package inclusion was treated as equivalent to named technology/workflow carry-forward
→ repair: generated source-bound ledgers + denominator carriers (§30–§32)

r1 symptom: manual evidence shuttle removed, but Web GPT still could not see host-bound receipts
→ root cause: evidence contract and evidence transport were conflated
→ repair: EVIDENCE_RETURN_PACK + separate immutable evidence commit (§12.5, §16.8)

r1 symptom: exact-SHA policy but CI template tested/identified merge-ref SHA
→ root cause: GitHub PR event identity not separated into head candidate vs merge test subject
→ repair: source_candidate_sha=head SHA; merge_test_sha separate (§12.2, §16.5)

r1 symptom: publish script could create repo after any gh error
→ root cause: repo bootstrap and candidate publication shared one error path
→ repair: one-time fail-closed bootstrap + publication that can never create repo (§16.3–16.4)

r1 symptom: source-quality conflict list named only a few KP R04 inversions
→ root cause: examples were mistaken for denominator closure
→ repair: deterministic 20/20 R04 quarantine (§4.3)
```

### 7.1 Minimum-Sufficient architecture

```text
GPTs_GENIEMAKER_開發實作+驗收指揮官
│
├─ Core Instructions
│  └─ role / authority / DESIGN-IMPORT-EVAL-DRIFT_PROBE-ACCEPTANCE router
│     + thin SWOF activation clause
│
├─ construction-acceptance-prompt-compiler/
│  ├─ SKILL.md                     # generic C0-C9 compiler
│  ├─ references/
│  │  ├─ canonical compiler refs/schema      # MUST be actually mounted
│  │  ├─ SWOF_HGK_AUTONOMOUS_CONSTRUCTION_ACCEPTANCE_RUNBOOK.md
│  │  ├─ SWOF_NAMED_CAPABILITY_CARRY_FORWARD.tsv
│  │  └─ SWOF_WORKFLOW_CARRY_FORWARD.tsv
│  └─ scripts/
│     └─ prompt_contract_compiler.py          # MUST be actually mounted
│
├─ Existing authoritative/project sources
│  ├─ PI00..17
│  ├─ PD00..15
│  ├─ GPT-B KP00..19 (R04 polarity rows quarantined until reconciled)
│  └─ current HGK/Fabric machine truth
│
├─ Knowledge-first admission
│  ├─ exact source corpus root (readonly)
│  ├─ Source Ledger + normalized locators
│  ├─ chunk/anchor registry
│  ├─ SQLite/FTS5 local-first retrieval or fresh-qualified native substitute
│  ├─ optional KG candidate (no authority promotion)
│  └─ positive/stale/superseded retrieval probes → SWOF-AI-KNOWLEDGE-ADMISSION/1
│
└─ Execution / acceptance projection
   ├─ HGK = sole normative control plane
   ├─ Fabric = governance/assurance/interop/knowledge contract surface
   ├─ Hermes = bounded runtime/orchestration
   ├─ Codex = bounded mutation writer
   ├─ Local SWOF root = construction target
   ├─ Git branch/worktree = bounded candidate workspace
   ├─ GitHub = acceptance mirror/transport only
   │   ├─ source candidate commit
   │   ├─ PR / portable CI
   │   └─ evidence commit
   └─ Web GPT = read-only external acceptance protocol
```

Operational invariant: no second Skill/compiler/orchestrator/MCP/workflow DB/knowledge authority is added.

### 8.1 Rule materialization law

```yaml
runbook_rule:
  rule_id: SWOF-RUN-R###
  type: MUST|SHOULD|MUST_NOT
  current_normative_basis:
    - exact-current-file:Lx-Ly
    - exact-current-file:RuleID
    - current-PDR-id-with-own-current-basis
  audit_repair_basis:
    - current-repair-audit:finding-id
    - historical-provenance-if-mounted
  executable: true|false
  unresolved_current_basis_policy: UNVERIFIED_REMOVE_FROM_EXECUTOR_PROMPT
  failure_disposition: FAIL|TEMP_CLOSED|DEGRADED
```

`audit_repair_basis` 可以缺席而不阻塞執行；`current_normative_basis` 不能缺。任何 rule/template若只剩 dead audit/history locator，必須 `UNVERIFIED_REMOVE_FROM_EXECUTOR_PROMPT`。這是 r3 No-Source-No-Norm executable-granularity gate。

### 8.2 R04 quarantine law

目前 20 個 GPT-B KP 的 `R04` row 均被 current audit辨識為 polarity-risk rows；本 Runbook **不使用任何 R04 row作正向 current_normative_basis**。需要其 intended semantics時，必須使用其他 current rule、current PI/PD、Compiler或 higher-authority reconciliation。R04 只保留 source-quality defect/provenance身份。

## 11. Knowledge-First Preflight — Source Freeze + AI Knowledge Admission + Reuse Admission

本節關閉 P0-001、P1-009與 REQ-05。`Source Freeze != AI Knowledge Admission != HGK/Fabric Reuse Admission`；三者缺一都不得把「施工前準備」宣稱 closed。

### 11.1 B1 — INITIAL_SOURCE_FREEZE（full corpus / no sampling）

**Exact source corpus root：**

```text
C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\知識庫\實作相關DOC\Fabric vNext\Semantic World OS Fabric\SWOF-F_SWOF-GENIE_All-IW_Pre-Dev_Multi-Packages
```

Source root在 B1/B2 期間 readonly。對該 root及 current required project controls執行：

```text
physical inventory
→ UTF-8/readability + raw bytes
→ raw_bytes_sha256
→ normalized_text_lf_sha256（text only）
→ logical duplicate/version/supersession groups
→ package/DOC identity + authority role + claim ceiling
→ exact current PI00..17 + PD00..15 subject resolution
→ full named technology/tool/provider/method scan
→ full WF/WP exact-token extraction
→ package-level denominator / external registry carrier capture
→ 20-KP source-quality quarantine
→ relevant PI/PD decision-corpus digest
→ named-capability/workflow ledger compile
→ source-freeze receipt
```

#### 11.1.1 Hash canonicalization

- `raw_bytes_sha256 = SHA256(exact file bytes)`；任何 byte-level packaging/readback用此值。
- `normalized_text_lf_sha256` 只對可成功 decode為 UTF-8/UTF-8-BOM 的 text計算：移除 BOM、`CRLF → LF`、孤立 `CR → LF`，其他字元與 final-newline狀態不改，再以 UTF-8 no-BOM encode計算 SHA-256。
- raw hash變但 normalized hash相同 => `BYTE_DRIFT_TEXT_EQUIVALENT`，不能自動當 semantic source drift；是否需重驗由該 consumer的 byte-sensitivity決定。
- normalized hash變 => `CONTENT_DRIFT`，影響 source admission與 dependent ledger/evidence。

#### 11.1.2 Deterministic inventory digest

對每個 source產生 canonical row：

```text
relative_path<TAB>raw_bytes_sha256<TAB>size_bytes<TAB>logical_lines\n
```

`relative_path` 使用 `/`、case保留；以 ordinal UTF-8 byte order依 relative_path排序；整體 UTF-8 no-BOM/LF serialization後 SHA-256。若只針對 PI/PD decision corpus，使用相同算法但 denominator固定為 current 34 package bodies；本 r3 materialization時該 digest為 `d7136c038d0f97717eeec44c1c127c26f7c363b0135d04d65bf7cfb5e863732f`。

### 11.2 B2 — AI_KNOWLEDGE_ADMISSION / AI知識庫物化（G-KNOW hard gate）

B1 closed後才允許物化 derived AI knowledge projection。預設 reuse HGK current Knowledge Workbench；依 current HGK projection，`SQLite/FTS5` 是 local-first P0 reuse，Qdrant/Neo4j default-off，GraphRAG/vector backend deferred。**執行時仍必須 fresh-probe current machine truth；不得因本文件記錄就假裝 backend仍 active。**

Required pipeline：

```text
Source Ledger
→ normalized locators (file + stable heading/line/hash identities)
→ heading-rich chunk registry
→ anchor registry
→ local FTS/RAG index materialization
→ optional KG candidate projection (only if current profile admits it)
→ retrieval trace + probes
→ SWOF-AI-KNOWLEDGE-ADMISSION/1 receipt
```

Canonical truth仍是 source files / Source Ledger / Shared Spine / Fabric contracts；Obsidian、LLM Wiki、RAG、KG均為 derived/candidate surface，不得 self-promote。

#### 11.2.1 Required knowledge acceptance probes

對 **34/34 PI/PD current package subjects** 至少逐 package驗：

1. canonical ID → exact current revision/version；
2. canonical ID → package mission / canonical domain；
3. canonical ID → claim ceiling / runtime non-claim；
4. canonical ID → major dependency / receiver / handoff locator；
5. named capability/workflow row → exact source locator round-trip；
6. stale/superseded version query → `HISTORICAL_ONLY` 或 reject，不得 silent merge；
7. nonexistent package/token → `NOT_FOUND/TEMP_CLOSED`，不得 hallucinate；
8. authority conflict fixture → quarantine + TT/CR，不得自行 reconcile。

## 12. Git Workspace / GitHub Acceptance Bridge Policy — Exact Source + Exact Evidence

### 12.1 Workspace decision table

| Task shape | Candidate branch | Dedicated worktree | PR | Remote CI |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| read-only source/research | No | No | No | No |
| evidence/qualification-only without repo mutation | No / exact ref | No | No | only if evidence target requires |
| truly atomic/direct/non-durable bounded mutation | HGK route decides; no durable-branch invariant | Optional | only if published as durable candidate | portable subset if applicable |
| **atomic but durable/tracked WorkOrder** | **Yes — MUST** | Optional | **Yes** | portable subset |
| normal durable code implementation | **Yes — MUST** | Recommended, not mandatory | **Yes** | portable subset |
| cross-role / restart-surviving | **Yes — MUST** | **Yes** | **Yes** | portable subset |
| parallel independent lanes | **Yes — MUST** | **Yes** | **Yes** | portable subset |
| security-sensitive / migration / rollback | **Yes — MUST** | **Yes** | **Yes** | portable subset + local host-bound gates |
| independent acceptance | read-only exact refs | isolated checkout optional | review existing PR | must not mutate candidate |

**Invariant:** `repo-mutating durable WorkOrder => unique branch`. `worktree` remains conditional. This removes the r2 “atomic tracked repair only if external candidate” ambiguity.

### 12.2 Identity model

```text
source_candidate_sha = exact 40-char commit SHA of PR head
event_sha            = workflow event commit identity
merge_test_sha       = PR merge-ref/ephemeral integration subject, only when the event actually provides one
evidence_commit_sha  = exact commit that contains sanitized EVIDENCE_RETURN_PACK
```

Hard law:

```text
source_candidate_sha != evidence_commit_sha
source_candidate_sha MUST NOT be silently replaced by event_sha or merge_test_sha
branch tip MUST NOT be an acceptance subject
evidence branch tip MUST NOT be an acceptance subject
workflow_dispatch MUST NOT manufacture a merge_test_sha
```

### 12.3 One-time bridge bootstrap

```text
BOOTSTRAP_ACCEPTANCE_BRIDGE
fresh gh auth
→ explicit org/repo-create permission
→ classify repository state
   ├─ authenticated exists → do not create
   ├─ explicit authenticated NOT_FOUND → creation may proceed only if authorized
   └─ auth/permission/network/unknown → TEMP_CLOSED; never infer absent
→ require clean local main baseline
→ create private shw097-team/SWOF only if authorized
→ push main
→ read back remote default branch == main
→ read back remote main SHA == local accepted bootstrap SHA
→ immutable bootstrap receipt
```

Candidate publication is a separate repeatable procedure and **never creates repo**.

### 12.4 Repeatable candidate publication — G9 enforced

```text
PUBLISH_CANDIDATE
remote repo MUST exist
→ branch matches wo/* or repair/* for durable repo mutation
→ load LocalClosureReceipt + IndependentReceipt
→ assert same WorkOrderId
→ assert same source_candidate_sha == local HEAD
→ assert same checkpoint_id
→ assert LocalClosure verdict PASS
→ assert Independent verdict PASS and checker != maker
→ clean workspace
→ freeze source_candidate_sha
→ push exact branch
→ remote branch SHA == local source_candidate_sha
→ open/reuse PR against existing main
→ assert PR.head.sha == source_candidate_sha
→ run applicable portable CI
```

### 12.5 EVIDENCE_RETURN_PACK/1

Manual giant evidence-MD transport remains superseded. Host/local evidence is sanitized, hashed, then committed separately.

```yaml
schema: SWOF-EVIDENCE-RETURN-PACK/1
workorder_id: WO-...
repo: shw097-team/SWOF
source_candidate_sha: <40-char source SHA>
local_checkpoint_id: <HGK checkpoint>
producer_identity: <maker/runtime producer>
checker_identity: <independent checker; MUST differ from producer>
local_closure_receipt_sha256: <sha256>
independent_receipt_sha256: <sha256>
redaction_receipt_sha256: <sha256>
secret_scan_receipt_sha256: <sha256>
evidence_items:
  - id: E-001
    type: diff|test_log|trace|security_negative|independent_receipt|rollback_receipt|runtime_receipt
    subject: <exact subject/hash>
    path: acceptance/evidence/<source_candidate_sha>/...
    sha256: <sha256>
    redaction: NONE|REDACTED
    claim_ceiling: <bounded claim>
environment_identity:
  os: <captured>
  runner_or_host: <captured>
  toolchain: {}
  lockfile_digests: {}
invalidation:
  - ON_NEW_SOURCE_CANDIDATE
  - ON_CHECKER_CHANGE
  - ON_REQUIRED_FIXTURE_CHANGE
  - ON_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_CHANGE_WHERE_RELEVANT
```

Transport preconditions：`producer != checker`；sanitized directory under admitted evidence root；no reparse-point/symlink escape；redaction receipt schema valid；secret/PII scan PASS；receipt subject/workorder/checkpoint all match source candidate。任一不成立 => `FAIL_SOD/FAIL_SECURITY/FAIL_EVIDENCE_LINKAGE`，不得 publish。

### 12.6 EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_READSET/1

```yaml
schema: SWOF-EXTERNAL-ACCEPTANCE-READSET/1
subject:
  repo: shw097-team/SWOF
  pr_number: <n>
  source_candidate_sha: <40-char>
  evidence_commit_sha: <40-char>
allowed_operations:
  - read_pr_metadata
  - read_exact_commit
  - read_diff
  - read_required_checks_and_workflow_runs
  - read_exact_evidence_commit
  - read_evidence_manifest_and_receipts
  - compare_commits
forbidden_operations:
  - create_or_update_file
  - create_or_update_branch
  - create_or_update_pr
  - merge
  - rerun_workflow
  - change_repo_settings
  - mutate_evidence
sequence:
  - assert source_candidate_sha is immutable 40-char SHA
  - fetch PR; assert PR.head_sha == source_candidate_sha
  - fetch exact source commit/diff
  - fetch required checks; verify subject and freshness
  - fetch exact evidence_commit_sha
  - verify evidence manifest hashes and linkage to source_candidate_sha
  - reject stale/foreign/proxy evidence
  - evaluate calibrated acceptance predicates
  - output PASS|PARTIAL|FAIL|TEMP_CLOSED with bounded claim
```

### 12.7 GitHub current-state policy（no dated state embedded）

Runbook正文**不保存**「repo目前存在/不存在、installation selection、auth狀態」等易漂移 observation。每次 bridge bootstrap/publication/external acceptance都 fresh-probe：

```yaml
schema: SWOF-GITHUB-FRESH-PROBE/1
required:
  - local_gh_auth_status
  - organization_scope_or_permission
  - repository_exact_state
  - default_branch
  - remote_head_or_pr_head_sha
classification:
  EXISTS: authenticated exact read succeeds
  ABSENT: authenticated exact NOT_FOUND only
  UNKNOWN: auth|permission|network|rate_limit|other ambiguity
unknown_policy: TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB
```

任何 dated support observation只允許留在外部 audit/provenance evidence，不得成為 reusable Runbook current truth。

## 13. Event Matrix — r3

| Event | Preconditions | Automated action | HITL | Evidence / terminal state |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SWOF_TASK_DETECTED` | SWOF identifiers/source family | load Compiler + Runbook; verify source-freeze/ledger freshness | No | C0-C9 contract or blocker |
| `INITIAL_SOURCE_FREEZE_REQUIRED` | new source set / digest drift | full physical read/hash + capability/WF ledgers + source-quality gate | No | `SWOF-INITIAL-SOURCE-FREEZE/2` |
| `TASK_TIME_RETRIEVAL` | source freeze closed | locator-first load only relevant exact rows | No | retrieval trace |
| `REPOCONTEXT_REQUIRED` | repo-bound task | fresh-read root/head/toolchain/instructions/permissions | credential only | RepoContext |
| `PD04_PACKET_REQUIRED` | any repo mutation | RepoContext → PD04 TaskSpecSeed/TaskSpec/WorkOrder/ONE ECP | No | packet refs |
| `WORKORDER_ADMITTED` | packet accepted | deterministic Direct/Kanban/Swarm + workspace route | No | WorkOrder + ExecutionBinding |
| `PARALLEL_OR_HIGH_RISK_MUTATION` | predicate true | allocate isolated worktree | No | workspace receipt |
| `LOCAL_TEST_FAIL` | candidate exists | first failing invariant → smallest affected repair | No | repair trace |
| `LOCAL_CANDIDATE_READY` | applicable local gates green | independent check + checkpoint + freeze source SHA | No | checkpoint + source SHA |
| `BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED` | remote repo absent by explicit 404 | run one-time bootstrap only after auth/org approval | Maybe | bootstrap receipt |
| `GITHUB_AUTH_OR_NETWORK_ERROR` | non-404 failure | stop; never create repo | Yes if credential | `TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB` |
| `PUBLISH_CANDIDATE` | remote/main exist; candidate clean | push branch; remote SHA readback; PR | No if preauthorized | PR + source SHA |
| `REMOTE_CI_APPLICABLE` | portable checks exist | unprivileged candidate-head verification | No | check receipt + env identity |
| `REMOTE_CI_NA` | host-bound/world-effect only | `N/A_WITH_REASON`; preserve local evidence requirement | No | applicability receipt |
| `LOCAL_EVIDENCE_READY` | raw receipts available | redact/hash → EVIDENCE_RETURN_PACK → evidence branch/commit | No | evidence commit SHA |
| `EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUESTED` | exact source+evidence IDs readable | run fixed readset, no writes | No | bounded verdict |
| `SOURCE_COMMIT_CHANGED` | new head | invalidate prior candidate-bound checks/acceptance | No | invalidation |
| `EVIDENCE_COMMIT_CHANGED` | new evidence | old verdict stays bound to old evidence commit; re-review as needed | No | invalidation/review |
| `DESTRUCTIVE_SCOPE_EXPANSION` | outside admitted write-set | block | **Yes** | approval/rejection |
| `RELEASE_OR_PRODUCTION` | separate authorized gate | do not infer from blueprint/candidate | **Yes/policy** | dedicated receipt |

Source basis：AUDIT `L87-L101,L123-L181,L435-L523,L628-L640`。

## 14. Permission Matrix — Policy, not UI Assumption

| Actor | Local SWOF write | HGK normative write | Fabric policy write | GitHub mutation | External acceptance | Release/Production |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Codex | bounded WorkOrder | No | No | via governed local Git path | No | No |
| Hermes | orchestration only | runtime state only | No | coordinate only | No | No |
| HGK | admitted bounded mutation | **sole control plane** | authorized contract path | candidate/evidence publication after gates | local/reducer governance | policy-authorized only |
| Acceptance Officer | **No candidate write** | verification receipt only | No | no candidate/evidence mutation | independent local acceptance | No |
| GitHub Actions candidate job | ephemeral checkout only | No | No | **No write (`contents: read`)** | portable check producer | No deploy |
| Web GPT external acceptor | No local write | No | No | **DENY ALL mutation by `EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_READSET/1`** | Yes, read-only | No |
| Human Policy/Release Owner | policy-approved | break-glass/approval | policy-approved | admin when explicitly needed | ratification | final high-risk/release authority |

Even if a connector gains additional UI capabilities, Web external acceptance remains read-only by contract.

## 15. Degrade Matrix — Fail-Closed

| Missing / failure | Must NOT do | Degraded behavior | Close condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Compiler support bundle missing | invent schema/script or claim compile pass | `PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED` | canonical bundle + hashes + compile/lint receipts |
| source-freeze digest changed | use old capability/WF ledgers | regenerate full ledgers | new freeze + ledger digests |
| quarantined KP R04 required | consume current polarity | exclude row; resolve higher authority or block | upstream reconciliation |
| PI16 external 555/353 registry row needed but registry not mounted | invent row content | `TEMP_CLOSED_REGISTRY_ROW` | exact registry source mounted/read |
| HGK/Fabric machine truth inaccessible | reuse operator manual as current truth | current-state claims `TEMP_CLOSED_STATE` | fresh machine readback |
| SWOF RepoContext unknown | guess stack/argv/CI | discovery packet first | exact RepoContext |
| PD04 packet lineage missing | mutate repo anyway | stop mutation | PD04 TaskSpec/ECP refs materialized |
| GitHub auth/network/403 error | assume repo absent/create | `TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB` | fresh auth + explicit state |
| repo explicit 404, create not authorized | auto-create | stop at approval gate | admitted creation authorization |
| remote main/default branch absent | publish wo/* anyway | bootstrap required first | bootstrap receipt |
| worktree unavailable | block every task | branch-only only if bounded single-writer proof | bounded workspace evidence |
| remote CI N/A | fail host-bound predicate or fake remote equivalent | `N/A_WITH_REASON`; require local qualified evidence | local subject-bound receipts |
| PR job needs secrets/write | add privileged token to candidate execution | split trusted/untrusted workflow; candidate job remains unprivileged | safe design accepted |
| evidence cannot be sanitized | upload sensitive raw data | keep local; external predicate `TEMP_CLOSED_EVIDENCE` | safe derived/raw receipt path |
| evidence branch advanced | accept branch tip | use exact prior evidence commit or re-review new commit | exact commit |
| connector gains write ability | allow Web GPT writes | readset denylist still applies | none; policy invariant |
| Actions logs/checks expired | trust summary | durable local/Fabric/evidence commit or TEMP_CLOSED | raw evidence restored |
| runner image drift | claim reproducibility from `windows-latest` | record actual environment identity | complete receipt |
| selected tool not runtime-qualified | treat design selection as active | explicit DEGRADED/native fallback/block | full qualification |

## 16. Minimum-Sufficient Code / Config Templates — r3 Operational Reference

> 本節是 Runbook-level directly-applicable template。每個 executable template同時記 `current_normative_basis[]` 與 `audit_repair_basis[]`；前者必須 current-resolvable，後者只作 repair provenance。template presence ≠ installed/deployed；缺 RepoContext/qualified tool/verified Action pin/required receipt時不可視為已部署。

```markdown
## SWOF project-specific routing

When the task targets SWOF / SWOF-F / SWOF-GENIE, or the governing source set
contains the SWOF PI-PKG / PD-PKG families:
```

```yaml
schema: SWOF-GITHUB-ACCEPTANCE-BRIDGE/2
local_canonical_target: 'C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF'
```

### 16.3 One-time `scripts/github/bootstrap-acceptance-bridge.ps1`

`current_normative_basis[] = [PDR-SWOF-001, 14_APPS_ACTIONS_MCP_ROUTEOUT.md:GPTB-KP14-R05,R06,R07,R08, 15_MEMORY_STATE_TRACE_REPLAY.md:GPTB-KP15-R03,R05,R07]`; `audit_repair_basis[] = [P2-011]`

```powershell
param(
  [string]$Owner = 'shw097-team',
  [string]$Repo = 'SWOF',
  [string]$LocalRoot = 'C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF',
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][switch]$AuthorizedCreateRepo
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location $LocalRoot

& gh auth status --hostname github.com
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB_AUTH' }

if (git status --porcelain) { throw 'Bootstrap requires a clean local main.' }
$branch = (git branch --show-current).Trim()
if ($branch -ne 'main') { throw "Bootstrap requires current branch main, got: $branch" }

git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Local main does not exist.' }
$localMain = (git rev-parse main).Trim()

$full = "$Owner/$Repo"
$probe = & gh api -i "/repos/$Owner/$Repo" 2>&1
$probeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$http = $null
foreach ($line in $probe) {
  if ("$line" -match '^HTTP/\S+\s+(\d{3})') { $http = [int]$Matches[1]; break }
}

if ($probeExit -eq 0) {
  throw "Remote $full already exists; bootstrap must not recreate it."
}
if ($http -ne 404) {
  throw "TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB_REPO_PROBE status=$http exit=$probeExit"
}
if (-not $AuthorizedCreateRepo) {
  throw 'Repository is explicitly absent, but creation is not authorized.'
}

$origin = git remote get-url origin 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $origin) {
  throw "Origin already exists ($origin); bootstrap requires explicit remote reconciliation."
}

& gh repo create $full --private --source . --remote origin
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Repository creation failed; do not retry as another state.' }

git push --set-upstream origin main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Initial main push failed.' }

$defaultBranch = (& gh repo view $full --json defaultBranchRef --jq '.defaultBranchRef.name').Trim()
if ($defaultBranch -ne 'main') { throw "Remote default branch mismatch: $defaultBranch" }

$remoteMain = ((git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/main') -split "`t")[0]
if ($remoteMain -ne $localMain) {
  throw "Remote main readback mismatch: local=$localMain remote=$remoteMain"
}

[ordered]@{
  schema = 'SWOF-BRIDGE-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT/1'
  repo = $full
  default_branch = $defaultBranch
  main_sha = $localMain
  result = 'PASS'
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
```

### 16.4 Repeatable `scripts/github/publish-candidate.ps1` — local closure enforced

`current_normative_basis[] = [SWOF-RUN-R010,R012,R014,R025, 10_AGENTIC_SWE_HARNESS.md:GPTB-KP10-R01,R02,R03,R05, 11_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_MATRIX.md:GPTB-KP11-R01,R05, 15_MEMORY_STATE_TRACE_REPLAY.md:GPTB-KP15-R03,R05,R07,R08]`; `audit_repair_basis[] = [P1-004]`

```powershell
param(
  [string]$Owner = 'shw097-team',
  [string]$Repo = 'SWOF',
  [string]$LocalRoot = 'C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF',
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$WorkOrderId,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$LocalClosureReceipt,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$IndependentReceipt
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location $LocalRoot

& gh auth status --hostname github.com
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB_AUTH' }
$full = "$Owner/$Repo"
& gh repo view $full --json nameWithOwner,defaultBranchRef | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB_REMOTE_NOT_READABLE; publication never creates repositories.' }

if (-not (Test-Path $LocalClosureReceipt)) { throw 'FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH: missing LocalClosureReceipt' }
if (-not (Test-Path $IndependentReceipt)) { throw 'FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH: missing IndependentReceipt' }
$lc = Get-Content $LocalClosureReceipt -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$ir = Get-Content $IndependentReceipt -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($lc.schema -ne 'SWOF-LOCAL-CLOSURE-RECEIPT/1') { throw 'FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH: bad local closure schema' }
if ($ir.schema -ne 'SWOF-INDEPENDENT-RECEIPT/1') { throw 'FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH: bad independent schema' }
if ($lc.workorder_id -ne $WorkOrderId -or $ir.workorder_id -ne $WorkOrderId) { throw 'FAIL_EVIDENCE_LINKAGE: WorkOrder mismatch' }
if ($lc.result -ne 'PASS' -or $ir.result -ne 'PASS') { throw 'FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH: closure not PASS' }
if (-not $lc.checkpoint_id -or $lc.checkpoint_id -ne $ir.checkpoint_id) { throw 'FAIL_EVIDENCE_LINKAGE: checkpoint mismatch' }
if ($ir.checker_identity -eq $ir.maker_identity) { throw 'FAIL_SOD: checker equals maker' }

if (git status --porcelain) { throw 'Candidate must be clean before freeze.' }
$branch = (git branch --show-current).Trim()
if ($branch -notmatch '^(wo|repair)/') { throw "FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_CANDIDATE: $branch" }
$sha = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim().ToLower()
if ($sha -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw "Invalid source candidate SHA: $sha" }
if ($lc.source_candidate_sha.ToLower() -ne $sha -or $ir.source_candidate_sha.ToLower() -ne $sha) { throw 'FAIL_PREMATURE_PUBLISH: same-HEAD receipt mismatch' }

$defaultBranch = (& gh repo view $full --json defaultBranchRef --jq '.defaultBranchRef.name').Trim()
if ($defaultBranch -ne 'main') { throw "Expected existing remote main; got $defaultBranch" }
$origin = (git remote get-url origin 2>$null)
if (-not $origin) { throw 'Missing origin; bootstrap/reconciliation required.' }

git push --set-upstream origin $branch
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Candidate push failed.' }
$remoteSha = ((git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$branch") -split "`t")[0]
if ($remoteSha -ne $sha) { throw "Remote readback mismatch: local=$sha remote=$remoteSha" }

$pr = (& gh pr list --repo $full --head $branch --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number').Trim()
if (-not $pr) {
  & gh pr create --repo $full --base main --head $branch --title $WorkOrderId `
    --body "source_candidate_sha=$sha`ncheckpoint_id=$($lc.checkpoint_id)`nExternal acceptance MUST bind this exact PR head SHA."
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'PR creation failed.' }
  $pr = (& gh pr list --repo $full --head $branch --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number').Trim()
}
$prHead = (& gh pr view $pr --repo $full --json headRefOid --jq '.headRefOid').Trim().ToLower()
if ($prHead -ne $sha) { throw "FAIL_SHA_CONFUSION: PR head=$prHead candidate=$sha" }

[ordered]@{
  schema = 'SWOF-CANDIDATE-PUBLICATION-RECEIPT/3'
  repo = $full
  workorder_id = $WorkOrderId
  checkpoint_id = $lc.checkpoint_id
  pr_number = [int]$pr
  branch = $branch
  source_candidate_sha = $sha
  local_closure_receipt_sha256 = (Get-FileHash $LocalClosureReceipt -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
  independent_receipt_sha256 = (Get-FileHash $IndependentReceipt -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
  result = 'PASS'
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
```

### 16.5 Corrected `.github/workflows/verify.yml` — event SHA separated from merge-test SHA

`current_normative_basis[] = [SWOF-RUN-R014,R015,R016,R030,R031, 10_AGENTIC_SWE_HARNESS.md:GPTB-KP10-R02,R03, 13_SECURITY_PRIVACY_PROMPT_INJECTION.md:GPTB-KP13-R02,R03,R07]`; `audit_repair_basis[] = [P2-012]`

```yaml
name: swof-portable-verify

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_sha:
        description: Exact source candidate commit SHA
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: swof-verify-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.candidate_sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  candidate-verify:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || inputs.candidate_sha }}
      EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      MERGE_TEST_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.sha || '' }}
      RUNNER_OS_ID: ${{ runner.os }}
      RUNNER_ARCH_ID: ${{ runner.arch }}
    steps:
      - name: Validate source candidate identity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if ($env:CANDIDATE_SHA -notmatch '^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$') { throw "Invalid candidate SHA: $env:CANDIDATE_SHA" }
          if ('${{ github.event_name }}' -eq 'workflow_dispatch' -and $env:MERGE_TEST_SHA) { throw 'workflow_dispatch must not claim merge_test_sha' }

      - name: Checkout exact source candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@<FULL_VERIFIED_SHA>
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.CANDIDATE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Read back exact source candidate
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($head -ne $env:CANDIDATE_SHA) { throw "Candidate mismatch: $head != $env:CANDIDATE_SHA" }
          "source_candidate_sha=$head" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append
          "event_sha=$env:EVENT_SHA" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append
          if ($env:MERGE_TEST_SHA) { "merge_test_sha=$env:MERGE_TEST_SHA" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append }
          else { "merge_test_sha=N_A" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append }

      - name: Portable verification
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/ci/verify-portable.ps1 -FailClosed

      - name: Capture non-authoritative CI environment receipt
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $receipt = [ordered]@{
            schema = 'SWOF-PORTABLE-CI-RECEIPT/3'
            source_candidate_sha = $env:CANDIDATE_SHA
            event_sha = $env:EVENT_SHA
            merge_test_sha = $(if ($env:MERGE_TEST_SHA) { $env:MERGE_TEST_SHA } else { $null })
            event_name = '${{ github.event_name }}'
            runner_os = $env:RUNNER_OS_ID
            runner_arch = $env:RUNNER_ARCH_ID
            image_os = $env:ImageOS
            image_version = $env:ImageVersion
            pwsh = (pwsh --version)
            git = (git --version)
            authoritative_for_host_runtime = $false
          }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .ci-receipts | Out-Null
          $receipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content .ci-receipts/portable-ci.json
```

**Trust law:** candidate job receives no repo/org secrets and no write token. `workflow_dispatch` captures an `event_sha` but `merge_test_sha = null/N_A`; a merge-result test, if needed, is a separate integration subject and may never replace `source_candidate_sha`.

### 16.6 Safer `scripts/ci/verify-portable.ps1`

`current_normative_basis[] = [SWOF-RUN-R016,R031, 13_SECURITY_PRIVACY_PROMPT_INJECTION.md:GPTB-KP13-R03,R07, 05_SDD_ADR_TASKSPEC.md:GPTB-KP05-R03]`; `audit_repair_basis[] = [workflow-command-injection-defense]`

```powershell
param(
  [switch]$FailClosed = $true,
  [string]$Manifest = './config/portable-checks.json'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repoRoot = (Resolve-Path '.').Path
$sha = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if ($sha -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw 'Cannot resolve exact candidate SHA.' }
if (git status --porcelain) { throw 'Portable verifier requires a clean checkout.' }
if (-not (Test-Path $Manifest)) { throw "Missing admitted manifest: $Manifest" }

$cfg = Get-Content $Manifest -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach ($check in $cfg.checks) {
  if (-not $check.id -or -not $check.script) { throw 'Check requires id + script.' }
  if ($check.script -match '\.\.') { throw "Parent traversal forbidden: $($check.script)" }
  if ($check.script -notmatch '^\./scripts/(project|ci/checks)/.+\.ps1$') {
    throw "Only admitted PowerShell scripts under scripts/project or scripts/ci/checks are allowed."
  }

  $resolved = (Resolve-Path $check.script).Path
  if (-not $resolved.StartsWith($repoRoot, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
    throw "Script escapes repository root: $resolved"
  }

  $args = @()
  if ($check.args) { $args = @($check.args | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) }
  & $resolved @args
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "FAILED: $($check.id)" }
}
Write-Host "PORTABLE_VERIFY_PASS source_candidate_sha=$sha"
```

The manifest cannot inject arbitrary `pwsh -Command` strings. Candidate code is still untrusted; safety comes from the unprivileged/no-secret/no-write workflow boundary plus ephemeral runner.

### 16.8 `scripts/github/publish-evidence-pack.ps1` — SoD/redaction/path linkage enforced

`current_normative_basis[] = [SWOF-RUN-R020,R021,R022,R025,R032, 11_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_MATRIX.md:GPTB-KP11-R01,R03,R05,R06,R08, 13_SECURITY_PRIVACY_PROMPT_INJECTION.md:GPTB-KP13-R02,R03,R07,R08]`; `audit_repair_basis[] = [P1-005]`

```powershell
param(
  [string]$Owner = 'shw097-team',
  [string]$Repo = 'SWOF',
  [string]$LocalRoot = 'C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF',
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$WorkOrderId,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$CheckpointId,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$SourceCandidateSha,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$SanitizedEvidenceDir,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$ProducerIdentity,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$CheckerIdentity,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$LocalClosureReceipt,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$IndependentReceipt
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if ($ProducerIdentity -eq $CheckerIdentity) { throw 'FAIL_SOD: producer == checker' }
if ($SourceCandidateSha -notmatch '^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$') { throw 'Invalid source candidate SHA.' }

$allowedEvidenceRoot = Join-Path $LocalRoot 'evidence\sanitized'
$allowed = (Resolve-Path $allowedEvidenceRoot).Path
$srcEvidence = (Resolve-Path $SanitizedEvidenceDir).Path
if (-not $srcEvidence.StartsWith($allowed, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'FAIL_SECURITY: evidence path outside admitted root' }
Get-ChildItem $srcEvidence -Force -Recurse | ForEach-Object {
  if (($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw "FAIL_SECURITY: reparse/symlink forbidden: $($_.FullName)" }
}

$redactionPath = Join-Path $srcEvidence 'redaction_receipt.json'
$secretPath = Join-Path $srcEvidence 'secret_scan_receipt.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $redactionPath) -or -not (Test-Path $secretPath)) { throw 'FAIL_SECURITY: required redaction/secret-scan receipts missing' }
$red = Get-Content $redactionPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$sec = Get-Content $secretPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($red.schema -ne 'SWOF-REDACTION-RECEIPT/1' -or $red.result -ne 'PASS') { throw 'FAIL_SECURITY: bad redaction receipt' }
if ($sec.schema -ne 'SWOF-SECRET-SCAN-RECEIPT/1' -or $sec.result -ne 'PASS') { throw 'FAIL_SECURITY: secret scan not PASS' }
foreach ($r in @($red,$sec)) {
  if ($r.workorder_id -ne $WorkOrderId -or $r.checkpoint_id -ne $CheckpointId -or $r.source_candidate_sha.ToLower() -ne $SourceCandidateSha.ToLower()) { throw 'FAIL_EVIDENCE_LINKAGE: sanitation subject mismatch' }
}

$lc = Get-Content $LocalClosureReceipt -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$ir = Get-Content $IndependentReceipt -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($lc.result -ne 'PASS' -or $ir.result -ne 'PASS') { throw 'FAIL_EVIDENCE_LINKAGE: closure receipt not PASS' }
foreach ($r in @($lc,$ir)) {
  if ($r.workorder_id -ne $WorkOrderId -or $r.checkpoint_id -ne $CheckpointId -or $r.source_candidate_sha.ToLower() -ne $SourceCandidateSha.ToLower()) { throw 'FAIL_EVIDENCE_LINKAGE: closure subject mismatch' }
}
if ($ir.checker_identity -eq $ir.maker_identity -or $ir.checker_identity -ne $CheckerIdentity) { throw 'FAIL_SOD: independent identity mismatch' }

Set-Location $LocalRoot
git cat-file -e "$SourceCandidateSha^{commit}"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Source candidate is not present locally.' }
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$branch = "evidence/$SourceCandidateSha/$WorkOrderId/$stamp"
$temp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("swof-evidence-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('n'))

try {
  git worktree add --detach $temp $SourceCandidateSha
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot create isolated evidence worktree.' }
  git -C $temp checkout -b $branch
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot create immutable evidence branch.' }

  $target = Join-Path $temp "acceptance/evidence/$SourceCandidateSha/$WorkOrderId"
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $target | Out-Null
  Copy-Item "$srcEvidence/*" $target -Recurse -Force

  $items = Get-ChildItem $target -File -Recurse | ForEach-Object {
    [ordered]@{
      path = $_.FullName.Substring($temp.Length + 1).Replace('\','/')
      sha256 = (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    }
  }
  $manifest = [ordered]@{
    schema = 'SWOF-EVIDENCE-RETURN-PACK/1'
    workorder_id = $WorkOrderId
    checkpoint_id = $CheckpointId
    source_candidate_sha = $SourceCandidateSha.ToLower()
    producer_identity = $ProducerIdentity
    checker_identity = $CheckerIdentity
    local_closure_receipt_sha256 = (Get-FileHash $LocalClosureReceipt -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    independent_receipt_sha256 = (Get-FileHash $IndependentReceipt -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    redaction_receipt_sha256 = (Get-FileHash $redactionPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    secret_scan_receipt_sha256 = (Get-FileHash $secretPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    generated_at = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
    evidence_items = @($items)
  }
  $manifestPath = Join-Path $target 'manifest.json'
  $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content $manifestPath -Encoding utf8

  git -C $temp add -- "acceptance/evidence/$SourceCandidateSha/$WorkOrderId"
  git -C $temp commit -m "evidence($WorkOrderId): bind $SourceCandidateSha"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Evidence commit failed.' }
  $evidenceSha = (git -C $temp rev-parse HEAD).Trim().ToLower()
  git -C $temp push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Evidence push failed.' }
  $remoteSha = ((git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$branch") -split "`t")[0]
  if ($remoteSha -ne $evidenceSha) { throw 'Evidence remote readback mismatch.' }

  [ordered]@{
    schema = 'SWOF-EVIDENCE-PUBLICATION-RECEIPT/2'
    workorder_id = $WorkOrderId
    checkpoint_id = $CheckpointId
    source_candidate_sha = $SourceCandidateSha.ToLower()
    evidence_commit_sha = $evidenceSha
    evidence_branch = $branch
    result = 'PASS'
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
}
finally {
  if (Test-Path $temp) { git worktree remove --force $temp | Out-Null }
}
```

## 17. GitHub Rules / Security Minimum — r3

### 17.1 Baseline

- `main`: no force push；durable mutation經 PR。
- Required check只要求**實際存在且 repo-portable**的 checks，避免 Gate Calibration Failure。
- Required checks/evidence須綁 current `source_candidate_sha`；新 source commit使舊 candidate-bound evidence失效。
- Candidate execution job：`pull_request`、`contents: read`、**no secrets**、no write token。
- `pull_request_target` 若存在，只能處理 trusted metadata/base-branch automation；不得 checkout + execute untrusted candidate code。
- external `uses:` full commit SHA pin；pin必須 fresh-verify來源。
- portable-check manifest不得攜任意 shell command string；只允許 admitted script path + args。
- runner/environment receipt記錄 OS/arch/image/toolchain/lockfile digest；`windows-latest` 不是 reproducibility proof。
- secrets/PII不得進 source candidate、evidence commit、workflow logs。
- 不預設 deploy/release workflow。

Source basis：AUDIT `L98-L100,L187-L196,L374-L434,L628-L640`; GitHub Secure Use + OWASP + zizmor SUPPORT。

### 17.2 Conditional hardening

| Capability | Default | Enable when | Authority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workflow execution protections | Optional | plan/org支援且有敏感workflow | SUPPORT / fresh-probe |
| Secret-scanning merge block | Optional | repo/plan支援、threat model需要 | SUPPORT / fresh-probe |
| CodeQL/code scanning | Optional | language/value/threat justify | Search-Before-Build |
| zizmor/Scorecard method | Optional | CI supply-chain surface需要 | method support only |
| Artifact Attestation | Deferred | actual distributable artifact exists | release-specific |
| SLSA target | Deferred | release threat model要求 | release-specific |

### 17.3 Trust-boundary invariant

```text
UNTRUSTED CANDIDATE CODE
    must execute only in
EPHEMERAL + NO_SECRET + NO_WRITE + READ_ONLY_TOKEN boundary

TRUSTED PRIVILEGED WORKFLOW
    must not execute
UNTRUSTED CHECKOUT / BUILD / TEST / CONFIG / DEPENDENCY CODE
```

Violation => `FAIL_WORKFLOW_TRUST`，不得以「CI green」補救。

## 18. Human WI（最小人類操作；7 authority-edge procedures）

Human只處理無法安全自動化的 authority edge。每個case固定欄位：`Trigger → Preconditions → Human action → Receipt → Resume token`；routine routing/testing/repair不得回推給Human。

| WI ID | Trigger | Preconditions | Exact Human action | Required receipt / secret handling | Resume token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| WI-H01 GitHub Credential | `gh auth`缺失/過期且 bridge route被選用 | repo action確實需要；scope最小化已列出 | 在本機受信任credential flow完成登入/授權；**不得把token貼入prompt/log/repo** | `GITHUB-AUTH-RECEIPT`只記account/org/scope/status/time，不含secret | `RESUME:GITHUB_AUTH_OK` |
| WI-H02 Org Repo Creation | authenticated exact probe = NOT_FOUND 且需建立 `shw097-team/SWOF` | auth已PASS；org policy允許；local main clean/accepted；create scope明確 | 批准/拒絕一次性 private repo creation；不得以403/network代替NOT_FOUND | `REPO-CREATE-AUTH-RECEIPT`：decision/actor/time/repo/visibility；不含credential | `RESUME:BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP` 或 `STOP:NO_REPO_AUTH` |
| WI-H03 Destructive Scope Expansion | executor需寫出 admitted target/write-set，或刪改不可逆資產 | affected paths、backup/rollback、impact、why-needed已列明 | 明確批准 exact paths/action/expiry，或拒絕；不可給模糊「全權」跨root授權 | `DESTRUCTIVE-SCOPE-RECEIPT` + rollback pointer + expiry | `RESUME:EXPANDED_SCOPE:<receipt>` |
| WI-H04 Constitutional / Equal-Rank Conflict | higher/equal-rank sources不可自動 reconcile | conflict locators、affected requirements、safe alternatives與TT已 materialize | 選擇 authoritative interpretation、要求新source、或維持TEMP_CLOSED | `AUTHORITY-ADJUDICATION-RECEIPT`：selected source/decision/non-goals/affected edges | `RESUME:AUTHORITY_RESOLVED` |
| WI-H05 High-Impact World Effect | PI06/PI12/HumanGate要求，或 consequential action不可由local test充分代表 | identity/entitlement/security/right/idempotency/currentness/rollback已PASS；exact effect已列出 | 批准/拒絕指定 effect、scope、time/window；不得授權未列明 side effects | `HUMANGATE-EFFECT-RECEIPT`；敏感資料只留受治理store，repo只放hash/ref | `RESUME:EFFECT_AUTHORIZED` |
| WI-H06 Release / Production | candidate申請Release/Production promotion | source/evidence exact identities、all required gates、open TT/CR、rollback、release scope已列出 | 依獨立 release authority批准/拒絕；local/external doc PASS不自動帶入 | `RELEASE-AUTH-RECEIPT` / `PRODUCTION-AUTH-RECEIPT`；exact subject + claim ceiling | `RESUME:RELEASE_GATE` / `STOP:RELEASE_DENIED` |
| WI-H07 Break-glass | normal control path unavailable且延誤本身造成更高已證明風險 | incident ID、why normal path impossible、minimum scope、timeout、rollback、observer已列明 | 明確批准 time-bounded minimum exception；到期自動撤銷；事後必review | `BREAK-GLASS-RECEIPT` + start/end + actor + scope + post-review TT | `RESUME:POST_BREAK_GLASS_REVIEW` |

### 18.1 Human WI common law

- Human approval只對 receipt中的 exact subject/scope/time有效；新 SHA、新路徑或擴張 effect需重新批准。
- Human不得被要求選 lane/agent/Skill/RAG/KG/worktree；那些由 HGK deterministic route處理。
- UI沒有明確批准結果時，不得推定同意。
- Secret只在credential system / governed secret store流動；receipt只保存不可逆ref/hash與scope metadata。
- 每個 WI receipt必須被WorkOrder/trace引用；沒有 receipt 的 authority edge保持 `TEMP_CLOSED/HITL_REQUIRED`。

## 19. New-Conversation Prompt Compilation Procedure — Deterministic r3

新對話收到「開始 / 繼續 / 修補 / 驗收 SWOF」時，順序固定：

```text
0. Detect SWOF trigger.
1. Load Prompt Compiler root + required canonical support bundle.
   If any required support artifact is missing -> PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED.
2. Load current r3 SWOF Runbook.
3. Resolve exact source_corpus_root and B1 source-freeze receipt.
4. If freeze missing/stale:
     run B1 INITIAL_SOURCE_FREEZE full-corpus/no-sampling;
     compute raw+LF-normalized hashes and deterministic inventory digests;
     regenerate relevant named-capability/workflow ledgers.
5. Resolve G-KNOW AI Knowledge Admission receipt.
   If missing/stale/failed:
     materialize Source Ledger -> locators -> chunks/anchors -> FTS/RAG -> probes;
     DO NOT enter RepoContext/PD04 mutation until PASS.
6. Apply 20-KP R04 source-quality quarantine; never use R04 as positive executor authority.
7. Fresh-read HGK/Fabric machine truth and produce/validate SWOF-ENGINEERING-BASE-REUSE/1.
8. TASK_TIME_RETRIEVAL:
     retrieve exact current KPs / PI-PD rows / named-capability/workflow rows needed for current task.
9. For each active major gate, materialize SWOF-GATE-CALIBRATION/1 row.
10. For repo mutation:
     RepoContext(PD03) -> PD04 construction packet -> TaskSpec/WO/ONE ECP.
11. Select exactly one Compiler ChangeSet.
12. Build C0-C9 JSON contract.
13. Validate current_normative_basis, named/workflow carry-forward, runtime readiness,
    permissions, GCF calibration, acceptance/evidence edges.
14. If blocked:
      emit exact blocker + close evidence + safe degraded path;
      DO NOT render executable HGK prompt.
15. If pass:
      render exactly existing ten-section thin executor prompt.
16. After execution returns:
      validate raw evidence, LocalClosureReceipt, IndependentReceipt,
      exact source candidate, redaction/secret receipt, exact evidence commit.
17. External acceptance:
      execute EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_READSET/1 read-only.
```

### 19.1 Initial freeze vs knowledge admission vs task-time retrieval

- **B1 Initial freeze** = full-corpus physical/source closure。
- **B2 AI Knowledge Admission** = derived retrieval materialization + positive/negative probes。
- **Task-time retrieval** = progressive disclosure only after B1+B2 currentness validation。
- new chat可 reuse receipt/ledger **only when exact digest/version/subject match**；不得靠conversation memory。
- PI16 exact `NAMED_TECH_TERMINAL_DISPOSITION_LEDGER#1..#555` / `WORKFLOW_REHOME_MATRIX#1..#353` body未掛載時，只有 range carrier；碰到 exact body需求 => `TEMP_CLOSED_REGISTRY_ROW`。

### 19.2 Compiler support-bundle dependency manifest

Actual `PROMPT_COMPILE_PASS` requires these physical artifacts because root `SKILL.md` references them：

```yaml
required_compiler_bundle:
  - references/source-routing.md
  - references/prompt-contract.schema.json
  - references/contract-model.md
  - references/activation-runtime.md
  - references/acceptance-evidence.md
  - references/termination-permissions.md
  - references/rendering-and-antipatterns.md
  - scripts/prompt_contract_compiler.py
missing_policy: PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED
no_embedded_reimplementation: true
```

本單一portable MD **不偽造**這8個缺失artifact；實際 deployment必須從canonical compiler bundle restore/mount後才能compile。

1. Mission / ChangeSet

### 20.2 Installation/readback gate

1. File write完成後以 final bytes重新讀取。
2. 驗證 UTF-8、heading anchors、code-fence balance、40 Runbook rules、regression probe IDs、§31/§32 ledger row counts/headers。
3. 若 separate TSV 尚未抽出，embedded §31/§32 可作 recovery carrier；但 task-time使用前仍須 source-freeze digest match。
4. 若 canonical Compiler support bundle 缺失，Runbook可以存在，但 `PROMPT_COMPILE_PASS` 必須 blocked。
5. 不因 Runbook安裝而修改 `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF`。
6. 不因 Runbook安裝而建立 GitHub repo。

### 20.3 No architecture reset / no wheel reinvention

不得為本 Runbook新增第二 SWOF Skill/compiler/orchestrator、GitHub MCP-only bridge、Codespaces-first施工 root、OpenHands第二 orchestrator、自建 workflow DB、worktree-everywhere或尚無 release threat model 的強制 attestation/SLSA。

## 21. Operational Acceptance Gates + Gate Calibration Failure Defense

### 21.1 Gate topology

| Gate | PASS predicate | Fail-closed result |
|---|---|---|
| G0 Source Corpus | exact required current sources inventoried/hashed; authority/supersession resolved | `TEMP_CLOSED_SOURCE` |
| **G-KNOW AI Knowledge Admission** | §11.2 receipt PASS; 34/34 positive current probes + stale/nonexistent/conflict negatives | `KNOWLEDGE_GATE_BLOCKED` |
| G1 Authority | no unresolved authority conflict on affected path | `FAIL_AUTHORITY` / TT |
| G2 Source Quality | quarantined polarity-risk rows excluded/reconciled | `FAIL_SOURCE_QUALITY` |
| G3 Named Capability Carry-Forward | all decision-bearing named rows/direct carriers valid | `FAIL_NAMED_CARRY_FORWARD` |
| G4 Workflow Carry-Forward | exact WF/WP tokens/families represented; no orphan/malformed wildcard | `FAIL_ORPHAN_WORKFLOW` |
| G5 Compiler Bundle | canonical refs/schema/script present and validators executable | `PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED` |
| G6 Current Machine Truth + Reuse | HGK/Fabric fresh-read + `SWOF-ENGINEERING-BASE-REUSE/1` usable | `TEMP_CLOSED_STATE` |
| G7 RepoContext + PD04 | repo/head/toolchain/instructions/permissions/write-set current; PD04 lineage complete | FAIL |
| G8 Workspace / Candidate | single writer; durable mutation unique branch; worktree when required | FAIL |
| G9 Local Construction Closure | focused + required negative/security/regression + independent checker + checkpoint | FAIL |
| G10 Candidate Identity | exact PR head source SHA; PR readback equals local same-subject closure | `FAIL_SHA_CONFUSION` |
| G11 GitHub Bridge | authenticated explicit state; bootstrap separate; no create on ambiguity | `TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB` |
| G12 Remote CI Trust | if applicable exact candidate/no secret/no write/pinned-admitted action/env receipt | `N/A_WITH_REASON` or FAIL |
| G13 Evidence Transport | producer != checker; sanitation/secret/path/linkage PASS; exact evidence commit | FAIL/TEMP_CLOSED |
| G14 Dual Identity / Web Readset | exact source SHA + evidence SHA + ordered read-only verification | FAIL/TEMP_CLOSED |
| G15 Claim/Release Boundary | claim <= raw evidence; Human/Release/Production separate | FAIL |

### 21.2 Strictness Matrix

| Strictness | Typical risk | Minimum closure |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | read-only/local/reversible | deterministic oracle + raw evidence + rollback/replay where relevant |
| S2 | durable repo mutation / external candidate | S1 + negative cases + regression baseline + independent checker + checkpoint |
| S3 | security/privacy/rights/provider/external acceptance | S2 + adversarial suite + least privilege + human calibration when authority/risk appetite involved + TT/CR explicit |
| S4 | physical/world effect/release/production/constitutional | S3 + dedicated qualified environment + HumanGate/release authority + fail-closed no proxy evidence |

Strictness只能因 higher-authority risk classification調整；不得為了提高PASS率自行降低。

### 21.3 Objective Function Registry

每個 gate必須先寫 outcome，再寫 metric。metric改善但 objective惡化 => gate FAIL/PARTIAL，不得「局部指標勝利」。

| Gate group | Objective function | Forbidden proxy-only PASS |
|---|---|---|
| G0–G4 | source/decision completeness without silent loss or authority laundering | file count、keyword hit、ledger row count alone |
| G5 | deterministic compiler correctness | SKILL file exists alone |
| G6–G8 | current usable engineering/repo binding with bounded mutation | manual says active、directory exists、branch name alone |
| G9 | implemented behavior satisfies TaskSpec acceptance without regression | unit-test green/coverage alone |
| G10–G12 | exact candidate reproducibility and safe portable verification | branch latest、merge SHA、CI green alone |
| G13–G14 | subject-bound raw evidence supports independent external decision | summary/prose/branch tip/action log alone |
| G15 | authorized bounded promotion at correct claim ceiling | prior local/doc/external PASS alone |

### 21.4 `SWOF-GATE-CALIBRATION/1` schema

```yaml
schema: SWOF-GATE-CALIBRATION/1
gate_id: G...
objective_function: <user/product/system outcome>
risk_tier: S1|S2|S3|S4
strictness:
  required_predicates: []
  threshold_or_exact_condition: <explicit>
negative_cases: []
adversarial_cases: []
regression_baseline:
  baseline_id: <exact>
  deliberate_allowed_delta: []
anti_overfit:
  holdout_or_cross_slice: []
  metric_improved_objective_worse_case: REQUIRED
deterministic_oracle:
  id: <exact>|N_A_WITH_REASON
llm_judge_policy:
  role: DISALLOWED | ADVISORY_ONLY
  rubric_id: <id|null>
  pair_order_counterbalance: REQUIRED_IF_USED
  order_a_b_result: <value|null>
  order_b_a_result: <value|null>
  disagreement_policy: OPEN_TT_AND_CALIBRATE
human_calibration: REQUIRED|OPTIONAL|N_A
raw_evidence_required: []
tt_cr:
  on_uncertainty: OPEN
  owner: <role>
  close_evidence: []
fail_closed_on:
  - objective_mismatch
  - stale_or_foreign_evidence
  - missing_raw_evidence
  - judge_order_flip_when_judge_is_used
  - local_metric_overfit
```

### 21.5 Major-gate calibration matrix

| Gate | Risk | Deterministic primary oracle | Negative/adversarial minimum | Regression/anti-overfit | LLM judge / Human |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G0 | S2 | source inventory+hash+supersession exactness | missing/current-vs-stale/duplicate conflict | previous freeze diff; no file-count-only PASS | judge N/A; Human only conflict |
| G-KNOW | S2 | locator/index/probe exact results | stale ID, nonexistent ID, conflict query, wrong owner | 34-package probe baseline; retrieval recall ≠ authority | judge advisory only if semantic probe; pair-order if used |
| G1 | S3 | authority rank/conflict resolver | equal-rank contradiction, injected override | prior authority map | Human required when unresolved constitutional conflict |
| G2 | S2 | source-quality quarantine list | polarity inversion fixture | 20-row quarantine baseline | judge N/A |
| G3 | S2 | exact named-row locator/hash | omitted selected row, bad carrier hash | ledger digest + adversarial name set | judge N/A |
| G4 | S2 | exact token/family equality | wildcard truncation, orphan WP/WF | workflow ledger digest | judge N/A |
| G5 | S3 | compiler lint/activation/acceptance/compile | missing dependency, dead source basis | known prompt compile cases | judge not substitute; Human N/A |
| G6 | S2 | fresh machine receipts + reuse map | manual-only state, do-not-redo missing | prior accepted reuse identity | judge N/A |
| G7 | S3 | RepoContext/PD04 schema+subject | guessed cwd/argv, stale HEAD, permission inflation | prior RepoContext invalidated on drift | judge N/A; Human only authority edge |
| G8 | S2 | branch/write-set/workspace invariants | durable-without-branch, parallel writer collision | workspace baseline | judge N/A |
| G9 | S3 | TaskSpec acceptance + independent receipt | security negative, rollback, stale fixture, false success | W0 + wave baseline; holdout/cross-slice | LLM judge advisory; counterbalanced; Human high-risk |
| G10 | S2 | PR.head == source SHA == closure receipts | branch tip moved, merge SHA substitution | prior candidate invalidated | judge N/A |
| G11 | S3 | authenticated exact repo-state readback | 401/403/network interpreted as absent | bridge bootstrap baseline | Human repo-create authority |
| G12 | S3 | exact checkout + admitted portable scripts | pull_request_target candidate exec, secret/write token, arbitrary command | runner/toolchain drift baseline | judge N/A |
| G13 | S3 | evidence manifest hashes+SoD+sanitation | producer==checker, secret fixture, symlink escape, bad linkage | evidence schema baseline | Human only if untransportable evidence policy |
| G14 | S3 | exact dual SHA ordered readset | stale evidence, mutable tip, write attempt | prior verdict bound to old SHA | judge may assist rubric only; counterbalance + independent verifier |
| G15 | S4 | release/production-specific authority + receipts | proxy PASS, open blocker, objective mismatch | release baseline + rollback | Human required; no LLM final authority |

### 21.6 Judge counterbalance + TT/CR loop

When any LLM judge is used：

1. deterministic oracle/rubric is frozen first；
2. same evidence is judged in `A→B` and `B→A`/shuffled order；
3. order-dependent verdict/score crossing threshold => `TT-JUDGE-ORDER-FLIP`；
4. affected gate becomes `PARTIAL/TEMP_CLOSED` until deterministic or Human calibration resolves；
5. judge output never overrides raw evidence or deterministic fail；
6. resolution records owner, close criteria, updated baseline and requalification scope in TT/CR register。

### 21.7 Gate application law

- `G-KNOW` precedes any new repo mutation/PD04 execution route。
- not every task needs G11–G14；only GitHub external acceptance route does。
- `remote CI = N/A_WITH_REASON` is legal for host-bound predicates。
- G9 must close before G10/G13 publication。
- new commit/source-freeze/index/environment-invalidating change invalidates dependent evidence by cone。
- Release/Production gate is never closed by this Runbook itself。

```text
Runbook_materialized
```

## 24. Overengineering Audit / Minimum-Sufficient Architecture Check

| Candidate addition | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Existing Compiler Skill + one Runbook reference | **ADOPT** | minimum change, deterministic activation, portable to plugin |
| Second full SWOF skill | **REJECT CURRENTLY** | duplicate triggers/authority, context bloat |
| Git branch per repo-mutating durable WO | **ADOPT** | low cost; candidate lineage/diff/rollback |
| Worktree for every WO | **REJECT UNIVERSAL RULE** | unnecessary for atomic/read-only/single-writer tasks |
| Conditional worktree | **ADOPT** | parallel/high-risk/cross-role/migration isolation |
| PR for durable repo mutation | **ADOPT** | review/diff/check envelope |
| Full remote CI duplicate of HGK | **REJECT** | host/runtime mismatch; second acceptance plane |
| Minimal portable remote CI | **ADOPT CONDITIONAL** | clean-checkout reproducibility / independent environment |
| GitHub MCP Server | **DEFER/NO CURRENT GAP** | `git + gh + existing connector` sufficient |
| Codespaces-first | **REJECT AS PRIMARY** | local HGK/Fabric/Windows truth is canonical for this project |
| OpenHands orchestrator | **REJECT** | second orchestration plane |
| OpenSSF Scorecard method | **ADOPT METHOD** | pinning/permissions/branch/supply-chain checks useful |
| Scorecard Action | **OPTIONAL** | add only when repo/release exposure justifies |
| Artifact attestation/SLSA | **DEFER** | only when distributable artifact exists |

Estimated Overengineering Index of recommended architecture: **~1.5–2 / 5** (engineering comparison only; not a normative project metric).

4. projection/manual-only currentness => TEMP_CLOSED，不得重造既有輪子。

### Phase C — SWOF RepoContext + PD04 packet + calibrated gates

1. inspect `C:\Projects\Agent_Workspace\SWOF` actual repo/head/toolchain/instructions/permissions/secret boundary。
2. PD03 RepoContext。
3. PD04 `TaskSpecSeed → TaskSpec → WorkOrder → ONE ECP`。
4. compile acceptance/evidence/rollback edges與mutation cone。
5. materialize `SWOF-GATE-CALIBRATION/1` rows for active major gates。
6. branch/worktree policy from task shape；durable repo mutation always unique branch。

### Phase D — Local construction waves

依 §10 W0–W5 dependency topology，以WorkOrder為mutation unit：

`implement → focused tests → first-failing invariant → smallest repair → affected regression + negative/security/adversarial → anti-overfit/holdout as required → independent checker → checkpoint → LocalClosureReceipt`

任何 LLM judge只可advisory；使用時必 pair-order counterbalance，order flip開TT。

### Phase E — GitHub acceptance bridge bootstrap（one-time / conditional）

only when external acceptance route needs it：
`gh auth → exact repo-state → authorized NOT_FOUND-only creation path → private repo → main push/readback → bootstrap receipt`。

### Phase F — Candidate publication

`LocalClosureReceipt + IndependentReceipt + same WO + same checkpoint + same HEAD PASS → clean workspace → exact source SHA → push unique branch → PR → PR.head readback == source SHA → applicable portable CI`。

### Phase G — Evidence publication

`producer != checker → admitted sanitized evidence root → no reparse/symlink escape → redaction receipt PASS → secret/PII scan PASS → same subject/workorder/checkpoint linkage → item hashes → exact evidence commit → remote readback`。

### Phase H — Web external acceptance

read-only ordered sequence：
`PR metadata → exact source commit → exact diff → calibrated required checks → exact evidence commit → manifest/raw receipts/hashes → linkage/invalidation → bounded verdict`。

### Phase I — Repair / Resume

`finding → first-failing invariant → affected dependency cone → smallest repair → new SHA → affected retest/regression → new evidence → re-accept`。舊 verdict只對舊 subject有效。

### Phase J — Controlled evolution

`DRIFT_PROBE → SUPPORT evidence → owner/source impact → targeted requalification → source/knowledge/ledger update as affected → smallest repair`。不得automatic architecture reset。

### 33.1 Zero-silent-loss law

任何後續修訂不得只刪掉「不方便」的 package/tool/workflow/evidence edge。必須 `RETAIN / REHOME / SUPERSEDE / DEFER_WITH_REASON / REJECT_WITH_REASON`，並保留 source locator與invalidation語義。

### 33.2 Source blueprint audit provenance

r2 blueprint已記錄並關閉其 author-side audit findings；本 Runbook materialization保留該設計/provenance，不把 blueprint-layer PASS升格為 task runtime/Independent/Release/Production PASS。

### 33.3 Runbook current-use rule

新對話應使用本 Runbook current version；只有在需要 audit/provenance drill-down時讀 r2 blueprint/討論稿。若 higher-authority/current source更新導致本檔規則失效，必須開 targeted repair、重新readback並升版；不得 silent patch conversation memory。
